ChangePasswordRequest.description:
A User replacing their own password: they must know the current one, and the new
one must meet the minimum strength ({@see Password::defaults()}).
ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest

GenerateVariantsRequest.description:
The Attribute values to generate a Product's Variants from (any number per
Attribute). An empty list makes the single Variant of a Product without Attributes.
GenerateVariantsRequest.title: GenerateVariantsRequest

Locale.description: The interface languages. Arabic is read right to left.
Locale.title: Locale

ProductBulkAction.description:
What the Products list can do to several Products at once. | | |---| | `activate`
| | `archive`
| | `delete`
Deletes the Products that may be deleted and skips the ones on Orders. |
ProductBulkAction.title: ProductBulkAction

ProductBulkActionRequest.description: One action (activate, archive or delete) on up to a page of Products.
ProductBulkActionRequest.title: ProductBulkActionRequest

ProductStatus.description: Where a Product stands in the catalog. A Product that appears on any Order can be Archived but never deleted.
ProductStatus.title: ProductStatus

ReorderProductImagesRequest.description:
A Product's images in their new order: each of its image ids exactly once; the first
becomes the main image.
ReorderProductImagesRequest.title: ReorderProductImagesRequest

StoreAttributeRequest.description:
An Attribute and its whole list of values, in display order. Each value has a name
and a code for generated SKUs ("Red", "RED"), both unique within the Attribute. When
editing, a value with an `id` is kept (and renamed), one without is new, and any value
left out is removed.
StoreAttributeRequest.title: StoreAttributeRequest

StoreBrandLogoRequest.description:
A Brand's logo: a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 1 MB. SVG is refused, because
an SVG served from our own origin can carry scripts.
StoreBrandLogoRequest.title: StoreBrandLogoRequest

StoreBrandRequest.description:
A new Brand: a name and an optional slug (generated from the name when left out).
The logo has its own endpoint (BrandLogoController), so this stays plain JSON.
StoreBrandRequest.title: StoreBrandRequest

StoreCategoryRequest.description:
A new Category: a name, an optional slug (generated from the name when left out),
an optional parent and an optional description. Whether the parent may hold children
is a business rule, checked under lock by CategoryHierarchy.
StoreCategoryRequest.title: StoreCategoryRequest

StoreProductImagesRequest.description:
New images for a Product (multipart): PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 2 MB each, and at
most ten per Product in all. SVG is refused, because an SVG served from our own
origin can carry scripts.
StoreProductImagesRequest.title: StoreProductImagesRequest

StoreProductRequest.description:
A Product's details. Prices are decimal strings with at most two decimals, entered
without VAT. The slug is generated from the name when left empty. Images and Variants
have their own endpoints.
StoreProductRequest.title: StoreProductRequest

UpdateAttributeRequest.description: An Attribute's new name and its whole new list of values.
UpdateAttributeRequest.title: UpdateAttributeRequest

UpdateBrandRequest.description: A Brand's new name and slug. An empty slug is generated again from the name.
UpdateBrandRequest.title: UpdateBrandRequest

UpdateCategoryRequest.description:
A Category's new values, all sent at once. An empty slug is generated again from the
name. The hierarchy rules (two levels, not its own parent) live in CategoryHierarchy.
UpdateCategoryRequest.title: UpdateCategoryRequest

UpdatePreferencesRequest.description:
The signed-in User's own language and theme. Every User may change their own, so
being signed in is the only requirement.
UpdatePreferencesRequest.title: UpdatePreferencesRequest

UpdateProductRequest.description: A Product's new details. An empty slug is generated again from the name.
UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest

UpdateVariantsRequest.description:
New values for some of a Product's Variants, saved together: SKU, price, Average cost
and Low-stock threshold (empty follows the store default). A SKU must be unique among
all Variants; Variants in the same save may swap SKUs.
UpdateVariantsRequest.title: UpdateVariantsRequest
